data.name: Will
data.long_meaning: From the Old English 'willa' or 'wilian', meaning 'to want' or 'to will'. In the Middle Ages, 'will' was used to mean the person's inner most self and willpower. In Christian context, the name symbolizes the power of God's will in the life of a believer.
